statement: I like the larger, bolder category names - that change is approved. The colour key makes the how-do page look cluttered without adding much value - let's abandon that idea.

nextWork: Preview contents-page colour treatments separately. Apply approved category names without further approval when next integrating the selected navigation changes; do not integrate the rejected key.
